chunks: He (Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him) said:
Whoever finds pleasure in water in this world, God — Mighty and Majestic — will make him enjoy from the drinks of Paradise.

key_terms.أَشْرِبَةِ الْجَنَّةِ: The drinks of Paradise — the celestial beverages described in the Quran, including pure, sealed wine and river of honey
key_terms.تَلَذَّذَ: To find pleasure, to delight in — implies conscious appreciation and enjoyment of a blessing

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about enjoying water and its reward in Paradise?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) teaches that appreciating and enjoying the blessing of water in this world is rewarded by God with the exquisite drinks of Paradise in the next. This hadith comes from the chapter on the merits of water in al-Kafi and reflects the Shia theological principle that gratitude for worldly blessings is reciprocated with heavenly rewards. The original audience — early Muslim scholars in 3rd-century AH Iraq — understood water as among the most vital and precious of God's gifts, making this a meaningful promise of eschatological recompense.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ibn Fazzal, from the one who informed him, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘The one who enjoys with the water in the world, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Make him enjoy from the drinks of the Paradise’.
en.sarwar: Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid from ibn Faddal from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If one enjoys and appreciates the taste of water in this world Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, will give him water in paradise.’”
